title: Docker Hub OAuth access token: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: dckx_oat_ vs the provider-documented dckr_oat_ Organization Access Token prefix. Twin of "Docker Hub OAuth access token and Docker Hub Personal access token: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
